2609.33665.title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
2609.33665.paper_summary: Automatically generated environments provide a scalable source of interaction data for training general agents. However, existing approaches mainly generate tasks within a single environment, while real-world workflows require agents to connect information and actions across multiple services. We introduce Compositional Environment Scaling (\textbf{CompoWorld}), which expands the task space by composing a finite library of reusable services. Coding agents turn tool specifications into verified services with typed states and shared interfaces, while a world model handles tools that cannot be reliably implemented. A random-walk procedure connects services through dependency graphs, enabling the generation and verification of tasks that require information to flow across services. Verified trajectories support supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while our Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides reinforcement learning (RL) toward full task completion by emphasizing criteria with lower pass rates within each rollout group. We construct 448 services exposing 10,130 tools and use 3K SFT trajectories and 1K RL tasks to train Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Experimental results show that CompoWorld improves on its backbone by 9.17 points on average across eight benchmarks. On AutomationBench, it surpasses frontier models such as Claude Opus 4.6 and leads all compared agent-specialized 35B-A3B models.
2609.33665.paper_summary_zh: 自動生成的環境提供了一個可擴展的互動數據來源，用於訓練通用代理。<lb/>然而，現有的方法主要是在單一環境中生成任務，而現實世界的工作流程則要求代理能夠在多個服務之間連接信息和行動。<lb/>我們引入了組合環境擴展（\textbf{CompoWorld}），通過組合有限的可重用服務庫來擴展任務空間。<lb/>編碼代理將工具規範轉化為具有類型狀態和共享接口的經過驗證的服務，而世界模型則處理那些無法可靠實現的工具。<lb/>隨機漫步程序通過依賴圖連接服務，從而實現生成和驗證需要信息在服務之間流動的任務。<lb/>經過驗證的軌跡支持監督微調（SFT），而我們的聚焦完成標準獎勵則通過強調每個回合組內較低通過率的標準，引導強化學習（RL）朝向完整任務的完成。<lb/>我們構建了448個服務，暴露出10,130個工具，並使用3K SFT軌跡和1K RL任務來訓練Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，CompoWorld在八個基準測試中平均提高了其基礎模型9.17分。<lb/>在AutomationBench上，它超越了前沿模型，如Claude Opus 4.6，並在所有比較的專門代理35B-A3B模型中領先。
